title: Morse index and spectral asymptotics of least-energy solutions to the Choquard equation in planar domains
summary: We investigate the Morse index and spectral asymptotics of least-energy solutions to the planar Choquard equation \begin{equation*} \begin{cases} -Δu = \displaystyle\left(\int_Ω \frac{u^{p+1}(y)}{|x - y|^α}dy\right) u^p & \text{in } Ω, \\ u > 0 & \text{in } Ω, \\ u = 0 & \text{on } \partial Ω, \end{cases} \end{equation*} where $Ω\subset\mathbb R^2$ is a smooth bounded domain and $0<α<1$. Under some geometric assumptions, we obtain sharp asymptotics for the first four eigenpairs of the linearized problem as $p\to+\infty$. The first eigenvalue is exactly $(2p+1)^{-1}$.
